name: Armaldo

attacks.name: Abyssal Drop
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. Choose a spot from among your opponent’s Active Spot and Bench. At the end of your opponent’s next turn, Knock Out the Pokémon in the spot you chose.

flavor:
Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer.
It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its
sharp claws to take down its quarry.

pokedex.text: NO. 0348 Plate Pokémon HT: 4'11" WT: 150.4 lbs.
